method.geometry: Constant declared-width disk swept along each positive-E model G0/G1/G2/G3 path, extruded over emitted full layer height. Physical deposited-bead shape is not measured.
method.endpoint_rule: Full-height nominal core is the intersection of the convex nominal floor shape at both layer boundaries; cap layers with empty core are kept separate.
method.empty_space_rule: Subtract all model-extrusion footprints; retain only free components connected to exterior at local inward coordinate u=-0.5. u=side*assembly X.

limits: A footprint intersects a nominal cavity only within the declared-width/full-height envelope; this is not a measured PETG plug or a proof of actual dimension.
Cap/partial layers do not have a positive full-height nominal core and are not counted as blocked interior layers.
Digital retention of some connected void does not imply nominal groove width/depth or pin insertion fit.
No print, re-slice, CAD edit, shrinkage/flow calibration, pressure or sealing experiment was performed.
